THE OPTICAL ARSENAL

Every image published by DYPOL Team is captured with pure physical optics. Zero artificial intelligence generation — just pure glass, sensors, and photons.

M
PRIMARY BODY

LEICA M11-D RANGEFINDER

Screen-less digital rangefinder forcing mechanical intuition and deliberate manual focus composition.

  • SENSOR: 60MP BSI Full-Frame
  • ISO: 64 - 50,000
  • DYNAMIC RANGE: 15 Stops
  • WEIGHT: 540g Matte Brass
H
MEDIUM FORMAT

HASSELBLAD X2D 100C

Extreme resolution medium format for tectonic architecture and museum-grade archival gallery prints.

  • SENSOR: 100MP 44×33mm CMOS
  • COLOR DEPTH: 16-Bit RAW
  • STABILIZATION: 5-Axis 7-Stop IBIS
  • STORAGE: 1TB Internal NVMe
N
FAST GLASS

LEICA NOCTILUX 50MM F/0.95

The world's fastest aspherical prime lens, creating dreamlike three-dimensional subject isolation.

  • APERTURE: f/0.95 - f/16
  • ELEMENTS: 8 in 5 Groups
  • BLADES: 11 Curved Diaphragm
  • MOUNT: Leica M Bayonet
S
CINE MOTION

SONY FX3 CINE LINE

Cinema camera used for nocturnal street dispatches and high-frame-rate kinetic lighting experiments.

  • SENSOR: 12.1MP Full-Frame Exmor
  • BASE ISO: Dual 800 / 12,800
  • CAPTURE: 4K 120p 10-Bit 4:2:2
  • COOLING: Active Silent Fan
